The '''palace''' of the [[Three Families]] was the headquarters and palace of the Three Families on [[Quesh]]. During the [[Quesh war]] in [[3642 BBY]], the palace was infiltrated by [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] and [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Cartel]] forces.<ref name="Adrenal Shutdown" />
